entities.summary: Antoinette Monsio Sayeh in Monrovia, Liberia is a Liberian economist. She was the Deputy Managing Director of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) until 2024. Sayeh served as the director of the African Department at the IMF from July 14, 2008, to August 31, 2016. She also was a Distinguished Visiting Fellow at the Center for Global Development.
